power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.desc: Makaʻu nā mea kolo iā ʻoe a ʻaʻole e hoʻokokoke.
power.neoorigins.feline_water_weakness.d: Lawe i ka pōʻino 0.5 i kēlā me kēia kekona i ka wai a i ʻole ka ua - ʻo ka hulu pulu ka pōʻino.
power.neoorigins.feline_hunger_drain.des: Hoʻopau i ka ikehu 30% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki ma mua o ke kanaka.
origins.neoorigins.golem.name: Golem
origins.neoorigins.golem.description: He pā kaua hele wāwae o ka hao a me ka makemake - aneane hiki ʻole ke hoʻoneʻe ʻia, akā lohi a palupalu i ka wela.
power.neoorigins.golem_natural_armor.des: Kū'ē Paʻa I - ʻo ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ka hao e haʻalele i nā puhi ʻoiai ʻaʻole i mākaukau.
power.neoorigins.golem_size.name: Pākuʻi kiʻekiʻe
power.neoorigins.golem_size.description: He 30% ka nui ma mua o ka mea pāʻani maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.golem_effect_immunity.d: He pale i ka make, maloo, a me ka pololi.
power.neoorigins.golem_slow_movement.des: He 25% ka lohi ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.golem_fire_weakness.des: Lawe ʻia he 80% o ka pōʻino mai ke ahi, ka pele, a me ka hoʻopili ʻana i ka pahu pelemaka - lawe ka hao i ka wela.
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.name: Caveborn
origins.neoorigins.caveborn.description: Hoʻokiʻekiʻe ʻia i loko o ka pōʻeleʻele - ʻai i ka pōhaku maka, ʻai i ka ʻeleʻele me nā lima ʻole, akā maloʻo i ka lā.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_night_vision.d: Hoʻopili nā maka i ka pōʻeleʻele - ʻaʻole pono nā lama.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.caveborn_no_fall_damage: ʻIke i ka pae ʻana ma ka ʻāina ʻole.ʻAʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_speed.d: E wāwahi i nā poloka a pau ʻelua wikiwiki - hāʻawi ka pōhaku i nā lima kamaʻāina.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_stone_fists.de: ʻO koʻu mau lima e like me ka ʻili pōhaku - wāwahi i nā ʻoʻa a me nā pōhaku me ka ʻole o nā mea hana.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_mining_fortune: ʻOiai ʻo Luck e hana ana (i hāʻawi ʻia e ka ʻai ʻana i ke daimana), hāʻule nā ​​palapala ʻaʻa me he mea lā me Fortune II.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.name: ʻAi Pōhaku
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_stone.desc: Hiki ke ʻai i ka pōhaku, ka pōhaku, ka granite, diorite, andesite, tuff, deepslate, cobbled deepslate, basalt, a me ka pōhaku ʻeleʻele no ka meaʻai maʻalahi.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.name: ʻAi ʻai Fungal
power.neoorigins.nether_fungus_diet.desc: He meaʻai kūpono ka ʻai ʻana i ka ʻupena a me ka ʻulaʻula i ka Nether - kaomi ʻākau e ʻai no 5 pololi a me 0.6 saturation.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_copper.des: Hiki ke ʻai i nā ʻāpana keleawe, ke keleawe maka, ka ʻai keleawe, ka ʻaila keleawe hohonu, a me nā poloka keleawe maka - he ʻai māmā ma waena o ka pōhaku a me ka hao.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.name: Palapa Hao
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_iron.descr: Hiki ke ʻai i nā mea hao, ka hao maka, nā hua hao, ka hao hao, ka hao hao hohonu, a me nā poloka hao maka - he ʻai kūpono no ka mea miner.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.name: ʻAi ʻulaʻula
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_gold.descr: Hiki ke ʻai i nā mea gula, ke gula maka, nā hua gula, ka ʻai gula, ka ʻai gula hohonu, ka ʻai gula ma lalo, a me nā poloka gula maka - ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka ʻai.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_diamond.de: Hiki ke ʻai i nā daimana, ʻonika daimana, a me nā mea ʻala daimana hohonu - hoʻohālikelike ʻia me kahi kāloti gula i ka saturation.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_eat_emerald.de: Hiki ke ʻai i nā emerald, emerald ore, a me deepslate emerald ore - ʻo ka ʻai momona loa o ka netherite.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
Hiki ke ʻai i nā netherite ingots, ʻōpala, a me nā ʻōpala kahiko - ka meaʻai momona loa ma ka honua.ʻAʻole e iho i lalo me ka ʻōpū piha.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_copper_bonus.d: Hāʻawi ka ʻai ʻana i ke keleawe i ka hanu wai I no 60 kekona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_iron_bonus.des: Hāʻawi ka ʻai ʻana i ka hao i ka wikiwiki I no 60 kekona.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_gold_bonus.des: Hāʻawi ka ʻai gula i ka Speed I no 2 mau minuke.
Hāʻawi ka ʻai daimana iā Luck II no 5 mau minuke - hiki iā Mining Fortune ke hana.
ʻO ka ʻai ʻana i ka emerald e hāʻawi i ka pale ahi no 5 mau minuke - hoʻomālamalama mau ka lā iā ʻoe, akā ʻaʻole hiki iā ia ke puhi hou iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_netherite_bonu: Hāʻawi ka ʻai ʻana i ka netherite i ka ikaika I a me ka Resistance I no 5 mau minuke.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_daylight_damag: Paʻa i ke ahi a lawe i 1 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona ke ʻike ʻia i ka lā pololei.
power.neoorigins.caveborn_small_frame.de: 85% ka nui o kahi mea pāʻani maʻamau - maʻalahi nā tunnels paʻa.
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.name: ʻO Sylvan
origins.neoorigins.sylvan.description: He ʻuhane o ka ululāʻau kahiko - wikiwiki i waena o nā kumulāʻau, aloha ʻia e nā holoholona hihiu, a hiki ke hoʻopili i nā ʻenemi me ka piʻi ʻana o nā aʻa.Ua hoolaia e ka ua, ua wela nae e ka Netera.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.name: Hoʻokahi me ke ʻano
power.neoorigins.sylvan_mobs_ignore.desc: Haʻalele ka poʻe ʻino iā ʻoe wale nō - hoʻopaʻi wale lākou inā e hahau mua ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_regen_in_water.d: Ho'ōla lohi i ka wā e pili ana me ka wai.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_forest_speed.des: Loaʻa i ka hoʻoikaika wikiwiki ʻana i ka biomes nahele.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_nether_damage.de: Lawe ʻo ia i 1 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i ka wā ma Nether biomes.Kāohi loa nā kāmaʻa Frost Walker i ka pōʻino.
origins.neoorigins.draconic.name: Draconic
origins.neoorigins.draconic.description: ʻO ka Dragon-blooded a me ka weliweli - palekana i ke ahi a me ka weliweli i nā holoholona, ​​akā, ʻaʻa koke ka lapalapa draconic i ka ikaika.
Ka pale ʻana i ke ahi, ka pele, ka pelemaka, a me ka ʻā ʻana - wela ke koko deragona.
'Au ma ka pele e like me ka 'au'au 'ana o kekahi ma ka wai.
power.neoorigins.draconic_lava_vision.de: ʻIke maopopo ma o ka pele, ʻaʻohe ohu a me ka ʻehu ʻā - ʻaʻohe mea huna i ka hohonu hoʻoheheʻe.
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.name: ʻEheu Cushion
power.neoorigins.draconic_slow_fall.desc: Wehe nā ʻēheu Vestigial i kou hāʻule - ʻaʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.draconic_scare_mobs.des: ʻO ka hapa nui o nā mea ola - nā holoholona, ​​nā kamaʻāina, nā holoholona hihiu - e holo i kou alo draconic.
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.name: Kūlana Kūlana
power.neoorigins.draconic_size.descripti: ʻO 20% ka nui ma mua o kahi mea pāʻani maʻamau - paʻakikī ke poina.
power.neoorigins.draconic_attack_bonus.d: Hāʻawi i 2 pōʻino hou i kēlā me kēia pā.
power.neoorigins.draconic_water_weakness: Lawe ʻia he 1.5 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona i ka wai a i ʻole ka ua - pono e hanu ke ahi.
power.neoorigins.draconic_hunger_drain.d: He 50% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o ka hoʻā ʻana i ka ikaika - wela ke ahi.
origins.neoorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origins.neoorigins.revenant.description: He kanaka auwana undead e hele ana i loko o ka mea a hoʻolei i nā kī o ka pala maloʻo - ʻaʻole hiki ke make a ʻike i ka pouli, akā hoʻōla mālie a wela i ka lā.
power.neoorigins.revenant_entity_group.d: Hoʻokaʻawale ʻia ma ke ʻano he undead.Hoʻopilikia ʻia e ke Ola koke, hoʻōla ʻia e ka pōʻino koke, pale ʻole i ka lāʻau.
power.neoorigins.revenant_water_breathin: ʻAʻole pono e hanu.Hiki ke ola mau loa ma lalo o ka wai.
power.neoorigins.revenant_night_vision.d: Hiki ke ʻike maopopo i ka pōʻeleʻele.E hoʻololi me ke kī ʻo Night Vision (paʻamau K).
power.neoorigins.revenant_daylight_damag: Paʻa i ke ahi a lawe i 2 pōʻino i kēlā me kēia kekona ke ʻike ʻia i ka lā pololei.
power.neoorigins.revenant_slow_regen.des: Hoʻemi ʻia ka hoʻōla hou ʻana o ke olakino kūlohelohe i 40% o ka mea maʻamau.
origins.neoorigins.tiny.name: liʻiliʻi
origins.neoorigins.tiny.description: He liʻiliʻi ke kiʻekiʻe akā wikiwiki a maʻalahi - piʻi i kekahi mea, huki i nā mea, akā paʻi e like me ka hulu.
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.name: liʻiliʻi
power.neoorigins.tiny_size.description: 50% ka nui o ka mea pāʻani maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.name: Paʻa ʻili
power.neoorigins.tiny_wall_climbing.desc: Hiki ke hoʻonui i kekahi pā me ka maʻalahi.
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.name: Scurry
power.neoorigins.tiny_speed_boost.descri: ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o 20% ma mua o ke kanaka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.nam: Māmā e like me ka hulu
power.neoorigins.tiny_no_fall_damage.des: He mea liʻiliʻi ka hāʻule ʻana.ʻAʻole lawe i ka pōʻino hāʻule.
power.neoorigins.tiny_item_magnetism.des: Ua huki ʻia nā mea mai kahi mamao aku.
power.neoorigins.tiny_attack_penalty.des: Hāʻawi i ka pōʻino 2 liʻiliʻi i kēlā me kēia pā.
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.name: ʻOpu liʻiliʻi
power.neoorigins.tiny_hunger_drain.descr: Pōloli 80% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki - puhi koke nā kino liʻiliʻi i ka meaʻai.
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.name: Ana Dragon
origins.neoorigins.cave_dragon.descripti: He deragona ahi a me ka pōhaku, i hānau ʻia ma lalo o ka honua.Hoʻoulu i ka wela a me ka pōʻeleʻele, a ulu i kona mana piha i ka manawa.
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.name: Ke Ana Dragon Form
power.neoorigins.cave_dragon_form.descri: E lawe i ke ʻano o ka deragona ana - he mea hana pelemaka a me ke aka.ʻO kāu mau ʻano deragona, ulu, a me kou hiki ke mālama ʻia e Dragon Survival.
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.name: Nahele Nahele
origins.neoorigins.forest_dragon.descrip: He deragona o ke aʻa a me ke kākalaioa, ma ka home i waena o nā lāʻau kahiko.ʻO ka hoʻomanawanui a me ke kūpaʻa, ʻoi aku ka ikaika i kona wā e oʻo ai.
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.name: ʻO ke Kino Nahele ʻO Dragon
power.neoorigins.forest_dragon_form.desc: E kiʻi i ke ʻano o ka deragona ululāʻau - he ʻano kumu waina a me ka make.ʻO kāu mau ʻano deragona, ulu, a me kou hiki ke mālama ʻia e Dragon Survival.
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.name: E dragon kai
origins.neoorigins.sea_dragon.descriptio: He deragona o ke au a me ka ino, i hanauia i ka wai hamama.ʻO ka wikiwiki ma lalo o nā nalu, hiki mai i kona ikaika piha me ka makahiki.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.name: Ke ʻano o ke Kai Dragon
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_form.descrip: E lawe i ke ʻano o ka deragona kai - he mea hana o kēia manawa a me ka uila.ʻO kāu mau ʻano deragona, ulu, a me kou hiki ke mālama ʻia e Dragon Survival.
power.neoorigins.sea_dragon_apex_hp.name: Leviatana
